summary: A balanced starting plan: the venue and catering take the largest shares, with the rest spread across decoration, photography and entertainment.

budgetLines.name: Venue hire
assumptions: A mid-range banquet hall or garden for one evening.
vendorNeeds: Step-free entrance and an accessible restroom
vendorQuestions: Is decoration included or allowed from outside vendors?

budgetLines.name: Catering
assumptions: A buffet dinner with two starters, three mains and one dessert.
vendorQuestions: What is the per-plate price for children?

budgetLines.name: Decoration and flowers
assumptions: Fresh flowers at the entrance and on each table.

budgetLines.name: Photography
assumptions: One photographer for the main event, edited photos only.
vendorNeeds: Delivery of edited photos within four weeks
vendorQuestions: How many edited photos are included?

budgetLines.name: Live band
assumptions: A three-hour set with their own sound system.

budgetLines.name: Invitations
assumptions: Digital invitations with a few printed cards for elders.

budgetLines.name: Guest transport
assumptions: One shuttle for older guests from the nearest station.

budgetLines.name: Permits and licences
assumptions: A music licence for the evening.

budgetLines.name: Favours and small items
assumptions: Small return gifts for each family.

tasks.title: Confirm accessibility arrangements with the venue

assumptions: No preferred venue was named, so a mid-range hall is assumed.
Guests are mostly local; only a shuttle for older guests is planned.
openQuestions: Do you already have a venue in mind?
Should children have their own menu?
